purpose: The four-panel instrument gallery of Figure 12 (section 9): v1 dashboard, v2 cockpit, genome chooser, 10 kW winner cartography. One pass, one commit.
head: c15d0e0c0a475ff45abd891ae8dbf992f9c6a64c
dataset_note: Three panels read no campaign row: v1 and v2 render the 10 kW canonical system from the tree (params_10kw(), settled at V = 11 m/s), and the chooser browses the telemetry CSVs without printing a value from one. The cartography panel decodes its ring stack from elite_archive.csv at the pin and prints no campaign quantity: its title carries the design tag and geometry descriptors only. No value elsewhere in the report is taken from any capture.
provenance_note: v1 and v2's renderer, render-captures-head.jl, lived in an untracked kit directory when the first pass ran; this kit carries a byte-identical copy (c1e7e35f...), so from the landing commit onward every renderer named here is in the tree. Figure 11's captures directory is itself still untracked, which is not this kit's to commit.

print.row_2: chooser + cartography, flush from 0.00 mm; the 1.82 mm the chooser leaves inside its cell reads as the row's trailing gutter
